# Welly Deals by Day

> An independent, free guide to weekly deals, happy hours, quiz nights and events across greater Wellington, New Zealand - central Wellington, Te Aro, Cuba St, Courtenay Place, Lambton Quay, the waterfront, Petone, Lower Hutt, Upper Hutt, Porirua and the Kapiti Coast. Community-rated, no account needed, no paid placement.

Run by one Wellingtonian. Deals are verified against the venue's own website, Facebook or Instagram before publishing, and re-checked on a 10-14 day cycle. Nothing is auto-scraped into the site unchecked.

## Burger Wellington 2026
Every burger in the Burger Wellington competition (part of Visa Wellington On a Plate, 3-23 August 2026), ranked by public rating rather than critic pick. 244 burgers, 244 venues, 49 suburbs. Largest: Te Aro (76), Wellington CBD (56), Petone (10), Porirua Central (10), Hutt Central (6), Paraparaumu Beach (6). Median price $27 (range $8.88-$45).

- [Burger Wellington 2026 - all 244 burgers, ranked](https://welly-deals-by-day.co.nz/burger-wellington-2026/): the full list with price, venue, suburb, ingredients, beer match and dietary flags for every burger.
- [Live burger leaderboard](https://welly-deals-by-day.co.nz/?burgers=1): interactive, community-rated, sortable by overall rating, price, quality and portion size.
